title: pi-x-ide.json
description: pi-x-ide configuration: <agent-dir>/extensions/pi-x-ide.json (global, agent-dir is $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR or ~/.pi/agent) and <project>/.pi/extensions/pi-x-ide.json (project, overrides global).

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor completion. Ignored at runtime.

sendContext.description: Attach IDE context to prompts. false starts every session paused (⊘); /ide skip or a widget click still toggles it for the current session.

fixPrompt.description: Custom prompt prefix when requesting a fix for IDE diagnostics. Use {DIAGNOSTIC} as a placeholder for the diagnostic context. If the placeholder is omitted, the diagnostic context is appended after your prompt.
fixPrompt.default:
Analyze the errors and warnings at the following location, and try to fix them:
{DIAGNOSTIC}

status_display.description: Where to show IDE connection status. Use "widget" for the above-editor widget (default), or "statusline" for the default footer status line.

zedNested.description: When Pi attaches to a Zed window opened on a folder below its working directory. "manual" (default): only via /ide. "auto": also at startup and while idle; never when Pi runs in the home directory or filesystem root.

env.description: Pi-side environment variables. Real environment variables override these values.

PI_X_IDE_AUTO_INSTALL.description: Controls VS Code extension auto-install. Values 0, false, and off disable it.

PI_X_IDE_ATTACH_SHORTCUT.description: Pi TUI shortcut for attaching the latest IDE selection. Set to off, none, false, or 0 to disable.

PI_X_IDE_HOST_OVERRIDE.description: Override the host Pi uses to connect to IDE WebSocket lock files. Useful for WSL2 or custom networking.

PI_X_IDE_ZED_DB.description: Override path to Zed's SQLite database.

PI_X_IDE_ZED_POLL_INTERVAL_MS.description: Polling interval in milliseconds when checking Zed's SQLite database for selection changes.

examples.fixPrompt:
Analyze the errors and warnings at the following location, and try to fix them:
{DIAGNOSTIC}
